swingstudio.title: Swing Studio
swingstudio.enabled.tip: Turns Swing Studio on or off completely. Off = everything like normal Minecraft.
swingstudio.mode.easy.tip: Just the essentials: presets, speed, swing reach, curve and size.
swingstudio.mode.normal.tip: Adds: swing type, curve editor, rotations, spins and how the item is held.
swingstudio.mode.hard.tip: Adds: mirroring, hit pause, wobble, idle float, hand lag and more.
swingstudio.mode.expert.tip: Everything: every axis on its own, the curve as numbers, stretching, rotation timing and preview pause.
swingstudio.target.all.tip: Settings for every item that has no settings of its own.
swingstudio.target.pick.tip: Pick one or more items, e.g. just the totem or all swords. Everything you change afterwards only applies to exactly those items.
swingstudio.custom.tip: Off = these items swing exactly like normal Minecraft, whatever is set.
swingstudio.search.none: Nothing found. Try another word, e.g. "fast", "turn" or "size".
swingstudio.search.more: %s more matches are hidden in "%s" mode. Click here to show them.
swingstudio.hidden_note: %s settings from higher modes are active right now. Click here to switch to "%s" mode and see them.
swingstudio.reset.all.tip: Resets "All items" to the normal Minecraft animation.
swingstudio.reset.items.tip: Deletes the own settings of the selected items. They use "All items" again afterwards.
swingstudio.test.tip: Swings once so you can see the animation. Not sent to the server.
swingstudio.preview.no_world: Open the editor inside a world (K key) to see the animation live on your hand.
swingstudio.invert.tip:
Inverted: the swing goes to the other side, and every extra rotation and spin turns the other way.
Point = try it, click = keep it.
swingstudio.keep_hold.tip: On = presets only change the swing. Position, rotation and size of your item stay the way you set them.
swingstudio.category.classic.tip: Normal swings, just nicer: faster, softer, heavier.
swingstudio.category.pvp.tip: Short, clean and fast – so you can see in a fight.
swingstudio.category.weapons.tip: Made for axe, mace, spear, shield and friends.
swingstudio.speed.tip:
How fast the animation plays. 100 % = normal, 200 % = twice as fast, 50 % = half as fast. Only changes the look, not your attack cooldown.
Right click or ↺ = back to default.
swingstudio.strength.tip:
How far arm and item move during the swing. 0 % = no base movement at all, 200 % = twice as far.
Right click or ↺ = back to default.
swingstudio.curve_presets.tip: When the swing is fast and when it is slow. Click the left side for the previous preset, the right side for the next.
swingstudio.curve_graph.tip: Drag the two red points to shape the curve yourself. Left is the start of the swing, right the end.
swingstudio.curve.narration: Curve editor: drag the two points to shape the curve
swingstudio.style.tip: Which base movement the swing makes.
swingstudio.style.auto.tip: Whatever the item normally does (usually a slash, a stab for spears).
swingstudio.style.chop.tip: Top to bottom, like an axe or hammer.
swingstudio.style.sweep.tip: Sideways across in front of you.
swingstudio.style.none.tip: No base movement – only your rotations.
swingstudio.mirror.tip: The swing goes to the other side (backhand).
swingstudio.hit_pause.tip:
Freezes the movement for a moment at the hit – feels heavier.
Right click or ↺ = back to default.
swingstudio.move_x.tip:
How much the base movement goes to the side. Minus = the other way.
Right click or ↺ = back to default.
swingstudio.move_y.tip:
How much the base movement goes up and down. Minus = the other way.
Right click or ↺ = back to default.
swingstudio.move_z.tip:
How much the base movement goes forward. Minus = the other way.
Right click or ↺ = back to default.
swingstudio.turn_strength.tip:
How much the item turns along with the base movement.
Right click or ↺ = back to default.
swingstudio.curve_x1.tip:
First curve point, horizontal (0 to 1).
Right click or ↺ = back to default.
swingstudio.curve_y1.tip:
First curve point, vertical. Below 0 = wind up.
Right click or ↺ = back to default.
swingstudio.curve_x2.tip:
Second curve point, horizontal (0 to 1).
Right click or ↺ = back to default.
swingstudio.curve_y2.tip:
Second curve point, vertical. Above 1 = overshoot.
Right click or ↺ = back to default.
swingstudio.tilt.tip:
Tilts the item forward (+) or backward (−) while swinging. Goes back at the end.
Right click or ↺ = back to default.
swingstudio.turn.tip:
Turns the item towards the middle of the screen (+) or outwards (−) while swinging.
Right click or ↺ = back to default.
swingstudio.roll.tip:
Rolls the item towards the middle (+) or outwards (−) while swinging.
Right click or ↺ = back to default.
swingstudio.peak.tip:
When during the swing the extra rotation is strongest. Small = early, big = late.
Right click or ↺ = back to default.
swingstudio.spin.tip: The item turns all the way around during the swing.
swingstudio.spin.top.tip: The item spins like a spinning top.
swingstudio.spin.screw.tip: The item spins like a screw.
swingstudio.spins.tip: How many full turns per swing. Minus = the other way. Pick a spin first.
swingstudio.wobble.tip:
The item wobbles back and forth during the swing and rings out.
Right click or ↺ = back to default.
swingstudio.wobble_speed.tip:
How often it wobbles back and forth per swing.
Right click or ↺ = back to default.
swingstudio.pos_x.tip:
Moves the item outwards (+) or towards the middle (−).
Right click or ↺ = back to default.
swingstudio.pos_y.tip:
Moves the item up (+) or down (−).
Right click or ↺ = back to default.
swingstudio.pos_z.tip:
Moves the item forward (+) or towards you (−).
Right click or ↺ = back to default.
swingstudio.rot_x.tip:
Tips the item forward (+) or backward (−), all the time.
Right click or ↺ = back to default.
swingstudio.rot_y.tip:
Turns the item towards the middle (+) or outwards (−), all the time.
Right click or ↺ = back to default.
swingstudio.rot_z.tip:
Leans the item towards the middle (+) or outwards (−), all the time.
Right click or ↺ = back to default.
swingstudio.rotate_swing.tip:
On = pitch, turn and lean rotate the whole swing – it goes in the rotated direction.
Off = only the item sits rotated in your hand, the swing stays normal.
swingstudio.size.tip:
How big the item looks in your hand. 100 % = normal.
Right click or ↺ = back to default.
swingstudio.stretch_x.tip:
Stretches or squashes the item sideways.
Right click or ↺ = back to default.
swingstudio.stretch_y.tip:
Stretches or squashes the item vertically.
Right click or ↺ = back to default.
swingstudio.stretch_z.tip:
Stretches or squashes the item in depth.
Right click or ↺ = back to default.
swingstudio.idle_bob.tip:
The item slowly floats up and down all the time, even without swinging. 0 = off.
Right click or ↺ = back to default.
swingstudio.idle_speed.tip:
How fast the float is.
Right click or ↺ = back to default.
swingstudio.sway.tip:
How much the hand lags behind when you look around. 0 % = stuck in place, 100 % = normal.
Right click or ↺ = back to default.
swingstudio.equip.tip:
Ticked (default) = like Minecraft: the item dips when switching and after every hit (cooldown).
Not ticked = the item always stays up.
swingstudio.auto_preview.tip: While the editor is open your hand swings on its own, so you see every change right away. Only visible to you.
swingstudio.preview_pause.tip:
How long the preview waits between two swings.
Right click or ↺ = back to default.
swingstudio.ignore_effects.tip: Normally these effects make your swing faster or slower. Ticked = your animation always stays the same.
swingstudio.copy_paste.tip: Move settings from one item to others.
swingstudio.copy.tip: Remembers the settings shown right now.
swingstudio.paste.tip: Applies the copied settings to whatever you are editing now.
swingstudio.clear_items.tip: Deletes the own settings of every item. Afterwards all items use "All items" again.
swingstudio.key_info: Open with the %s key (change it in Options → Controls).
swingstudio.picker.title: Which items do you want to edit?
swingstudio.picker.help: Click items or drag over them. Yellow corner = own settings.
swingstudio.picker.held.tip: Adds the item you are holding right now.
swingstudio.picker.all_shown.tip: Selects every item shown right now – e.g. click "Swords" first, then this: all swords.
swingstudio.picker.selected.none: Nothing selected yet – then you edit "All items".
swingstudio.p.old_school.desc: A bit more turn, like back then.
swingstudio.p.crit.desc: Overhead chop with a hit pause.
swingstudio.p.cinematic.desc: Slow and big like in a movie.
swingstudio.p.silk.desc: Wind up, overshoot, a little wobble.
swingstudio.p.late_turn.desc: Tips only at the end of the swing.
swingstudio.p.ghost.desc: No movement, just a slight wobble.
swingstudio.p.statue.desc: The item does not move at all.
swingstudio.only_changed.tip: Shows only the settings you changed – from every page and mode. So you see at once what is different.
swingstudio.only_changed.none: Everything is still default – nothing changed.
swingstudio.preview_speed.tip: Plays the preview slower so you can see exactly how the item moves. Only here in the editor.
swingstudio.freeze.tip: Holds the hand in the middle of the swing. Pick the moment with the slider below.
swingstudio.freeze_moment.tip: Which moment of the swing is shown: 0 % = start, about 25 % = hit, 100 % = end.
swingstudio.compare.tip: Shows the normal Minecraft animation for comparison while it is on.
swingstudio.preview.title: Preview
swingstudio.hint.none: Point at a slider – this shows what it moves.
swingstudio.hint.move_x: Sideways: + moves outwards, − towards the middle.
swingstudio.hint.move_z: Forward/back: + away from you, − towards you.
swingstudio.hint.turn_x: Tips forward (+) or back (−), like nodding.
swingstudio.hint.turn_y: Turns to the middle (+) or outwards (−), like shaking your head.
swingstudio.hint.turn_z: Turns around its own axis, like a steering wheel.
swingstudio.hint.scale: Makes the item bigger or smaller.
swingstudio.hint.time: Changes the timing: when the swing is fast and when it is slow.
swingstudio.alternate.tip: Every second swing goes to the other side – like a combo.
swingstudio.variation.tip:
Each swing is up to this many percent bigger or smaller – feels more alive.
Right click or ↺ = back to default.
swingstudio.push_x.tip:
Pushes the item sideways for a moment during the swing (+ = outwards).
Right click or ↺ = back to default.
swingstudio.push_y.tip:
Lifts the item for a moment during the swing (+) or pushes it down (−).
Right click or ↺ = back to default.
swingstudio.push_z.tip:
Thrusts the item forward during the swing (+) or pulls it back (−).
Right click or ↺ = back to default.
swingstudio.pop.tip:
The item briefly gets bigger (above 100 %) or smaller (below 100 %) at the hit.
Right click or ↺ = back to default.
swingstudio.idle_rock.tip:
The item gently rocks back and forth, even without swinging. 0 = off.
Right click or ↺ = back to default.
swingstudio.p.organic.desc: Every swing is a little different.
swingstudio.alternate_vertical.tip:
Every second swing goes bottom to top instead of top to bottom.
Together with "left/right" the swings go round all four ways.
swingstudio.alternate_vertical.keys: combo up down top bottom alternate upward
swingstudio.p.combo_ud.desc: Alternates from above and from below.
swingstudio.p.combo_four.desc: In turn: normal, side, below, both.
swingstudio.p.slow_pvp.desc: Recreated from Grim Client: tips away at once, comes back slowly. Brings its own hold.
swingstudio.direction_vertical.tip: Whether the swing goes down or up – whatever type is set.
swingstudio.direction_vertical.keys: up down top bottom flip swap alternate direction
swingstudio.direction_vertical.alternate: One swing this way, the next the other way – taking turns.
swingstudio.direction_side.tip: Which side the swing goes to.
swingstudio.direction_side.keys: left right side mirror mirrored backhand swap alternate direction
swingstudio.direction_side.normal.tip: Normal: the swing goes towards the middle.
swingstudio.direction_side.flipped.tip: Always swapped: every swing goes to the other side (backhand).
swingstudio.direction_side.alternate.tip:
Normal, then mirrored, then normal again – taking turns.
With "Alternate" on Up/Down too, the swings go round all four ways.
swingstudio.saves.heading: Save
swingstudio.saves.name: Name, e.g. PvP main
swingstudio.saves.save.tip: Saves all your settings (all items, item-specific settings, general) under this name. Bring them back later with "Load".
swingstudio.saves.empty: Nothing saved yet. Type a name above and click "Save".
swingstudio.saves.broken: "%s" could not be loaded – the file is broken.
swingstudio.saves.failed: Saving did not work (see the log).
swingstudio.share.heading: Share & import
swingstudio.share.copy.tip: Copies your whole setup as a text code. Send it in Discord, for example.
swingstudio.share.paste.tip: Loads a code (or JSON text) from the clipboard. Your current setup is replaced – Ctrl+Z brings it back.
swingstudio.share.export.tip: Saves your setup as a .json file in the exports folder.
swingstudio.share.folder.tip: Opens the exports folder in your file manager.
swingstudio.share.help: To import a file: just drag the .json file onto the Minecraft window while this editor is open.
swingstudio.share.invalid: That is not a Swing Studio setup.
swingstudio.share.exported: Saved as %s in the exports folder.
swingstudio.direction_vertical.natural.t: Whatever the chosen type does (most go down, "Upward" goes up).
swingstudio.direction_vertical.down.tip: Every swing goes from top to bottom.
swingstudio.direction_vertical.up.tip: Every swing goes from bottom to top.
